_notes.swd_gpios: GPIO 0+1 are RESERVED for SWD level shifter enable (always output LOW). Do NOT assign any fixture channel to pin 0 or 1.
_notes.gpio_pins: Pins 2-6 available for Stage 4 stimulus. Assignments are PROVISIONAL — verify against actual fixture wiring when hardware arrives. Button=2, on_skin=3, peltier=4, charger_relay=5.
_notes.led_adc_channels: Channels 4-6 are Stage 4 additions for photodiode RGB LED sensing.
_notes.manufacturing_adc: ch0=power rail (~4.5V), ch1=battery divider (~2.5V), ch2=backup rail (~4.5V), ch3=SYS (~0V unused), ch7=3.3V ref
_notes.peltier_adc: Using ch7 (3.3V ref) as temp sensor channel placeholder. Actual NTC thermistor channel TBD.
